label: Monkey King
description: an agile monkey-style kung-fu fighter inspired by the Monkey King of Journey to the West: a cheeky monkey-like face with golden-tan fur on the face and arms, a thin gold circlet on the head, a red and gold armoured vest, a tiger-skin kilt over yellow trousers, black boots, holding a long red staff with gold bands at both ends
portrait: a cocky grin, the gold-banded staff resting on one shoulder, one hand shading the eyes as if spotting a rival

moves.idle: bouncy, crouched monkey-style kung-fu, staff held across the body
moves.light: A fast straight staff jab toward the LEFT at head height, the staff pushed forward with both hands.
moves.light_hit: the staff tip jabbing forward to the LEFT at head height
moves.heavy: A low spinning staff sweep along the ground toward the LEFT, aimed at the ankles, the body crouched low.
moves.heavy_hit: the staff sweeping low to the LEFT just above the ground
moves.charge: His eyes glow gold and gold dust with small white cloud puffs swirls around him and the staff (gold and white only).
moves.special_fx: Gold dust and white cloud puffs follow the staff (gold and white only).
hits: a rapid spinning staff strike with a gold arc
a leaping staff swing with gold dust
a huge overhead staff slam releasing a gold shockwave along the ground
